tips.li: A moral guide's Convert ability works best on someone wavering who likes the guide. Content colonists win their certainty back day by day, so a low mood helps a conversion along and a good one slows it.
The conversion ritual lets the moral guide speak to one listener with everyone watching; a well-made altar or ideogram and a good speaker make it likelier to work.
Each ideoligion with no moral guide here has no one to speak for it. Naming one gives its believers a voice, and the colony's other ideoligions someone to listen to.
Talks between believers move certainty slowly: a devout, well-liked colonist who comes out of a friendly talk well sways the other a little, and an argument only makes both dig in.
